items.description: Synchron and Nvidia are collaborating to develop an AI model trained on neural data from Synchron's brain-computer interface devices. The project aims to create a cognitive AI model, Chiral, using Nvidia's Holoscan platform for real-time processing. This initiative seeks to empower individuals with disabilities by improving communication and motor control through advanced AI technology.
